title: An immediate need meets borrowing
hook: Two stated cases: explore the next-period debt from a stated short-term payment.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the next-period debt from a stated short-term payment affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Next, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the next-period debt from a stated short-term payment in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
